title: Mod ↔ plugin on one server-side project
text: Move one server-side project across the mod and plugin line: a Forge or Fabric mod with no client code to a Paper plugin (events, commands, scheduler and config mapped to the Bukkit API), and a plugin the other way. Client code, mixins into the game and new blocks or items cannot exist on a plugin server, so the port stops and names each one instead of dropping it.
